justification: Changes when the DCP monitor re-points a chapter's stored source link; chapter checks unchanged.

pre_impl.existing_data: 7 active chapters match more than one link on their council list (2026-10-24): woollahra c2/c3/f1 (DCP 2015 + repealed pre-2015 plan), randwick b7/c1 (Stage 2 final + draft), leichhardt part-c-s2, marrickville cover.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: diff_urls assumed one link per chapter; it kept the last link and re-pointed the registry, flipping Woollahra between in-force and repealed plans and leaving Randwick on a draft.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Adds DiffResult.ambiguous next to url_migrated; alerts through the existing per-council digest.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: a chapter matched by two links is re-pointed, or not reported
falsifiable_check.observed_red: 4 hand mutants killed after tightening the reseed test; the old Woollahra test that expected migration into the archive failed and was rewritten to expect no migration.

functions.name: diff_urls
functions.input: hub-discovered links, stored registry rows, expected count
functions.output: DiffResult with url_migrated only for single-link keys and ambiguous for keys with two or more links
functions.if_none: a key absent from the hub is unlisted or removed as before

break_it.scenario: Woollahra lists a DCP 2015 chapter and its repealed plan
break_it.what_happens: silent: stored link flipped to the repealed plan
break_it.how: two links never re-point; alert names both

break_it.scenario: Randwick lists the in-force Stage 2 file and a draft
break_it.what_happens: silent: stored link stayed on the draft
break_it.how: reported every run until a person picks the in-force link

break_it.scenario: Someone runs a manual reseed of the registry

real_layer_exempt.scripts/r2_monitor.py: diff_urls is pure; tested on the real saved council lists; councils block this machine, so the live run is measured on Railway (next run's hub alerts).

post_merge.manual_verify: Next run log shows [AMBIGUOUS] for the 7 chapters and no [URL MIGRATED] for them.
